events.title: The Ark Toddler Group
events.description:
This group is run by Coopers Edge Community Church and our hope is this will be a place of sanctuary, fun and belonging for the families of Coopers Edge.

Our time together looks like:

9.30am Doors open

9.30-10.30am Free Play - help yourself to coffee!

10.30am Tidy Up Time

10.40am Song Time

10.50am Snack and Bible Story

events.title: Celebration Sunday
events.description: We meet to worship, share good news stories, and celebrate all that God is doing in our lives and around Coopers Edge.

events.title: Equip Sunday
events.description:
Worship, prayer, and learning from God's Word.

Children's provision is provided for ages 3 to 11.

Afterwards, we stay to fellowship, providing a light sandwich tea from 5pm.

events.title: Gathering Sunday
events.description:
Hear a story about Jesus, discover that story for ourselves, and enjoy a hot chocolate!

Full of fun and energy, experience Church in a new way that is accessible to the young and beyond.
